verdict.rationale: Together AI's docs claim strong speed characteristics—serverless with 'no provisioning latency,' dedicated endpoints with 'Better performance' and 'No hard rate limits,' dynamic rate limits that scale with usage, and SSE streaming support—which together suggest a design oriented toward low-latency, high-throughput serving. However, an independent community comment directly contradicts this, stating 'Together AI is at the bottom of the pile' on price/performance compared to Cerebras, DeepInfra, and Hyperbolic, while another commenter praises its speed as 'good speed,' creating a genuine conflict between vendor claims and hands-on community assessment. Missing for 10: quantitative TTFT/throughput benchmarks, first-party latency SLAs, and resolution of the conflicting independent performance comparisons.
